description: Mock-backed real-world Homepage usage scenarios tracked for Daemun release gates. Quick scenarios are release-blocking; soak scenarios are manual/nightly leak checks.

scenarios.description: Covers Glances-backed host metrics with optional uptime, CPU temperature, and disk payloads.
Covers local resource widget API calls that users commonly pin next to service widgets.
Covers YAML settings/services/bookmarks/widgets bootstrapping through Hono without binding the app to a port.
